03892d.content:
# Application & Auth Recon Summary

Target URL: http://host.docker.internal:5173
Codebase: /workspace/build-medical

Default Seed Users (from `scripts/seed.ts`):
- `admin` / `admin123` (Role: `owner_admin`)
- `biller` / `biller123` (Role: `biller`)
- `qaverify` / `Verify123!` (Role: `owner_admin`)
- `atul_admin` / `mederp123` (Role: `owner_admin`)

Key Attack Surfaces:
1. Authentication & Sessions: `hooks.server.ts`, `/login`, `/register`, cookie-based sessions with 7-day TTL.
2. User Management: `/api/users`, `/api/users/[id]` (GET, POST, PATCH).
3. Backups: `/api/settings/backup`, `/api/settings/backup/download` (`pg_dump` and `psql` invocations, file streaming).
4. Network Settings: `/api/settings/network` (exposes system interfaces, IP, port, connected devices, QR code).
5. Sync Engine: `/api/sync/pull`, `/api/sync/push`.
6. ERP Core APIs: `/api/sales/*`, `/api/purchases/*`, `/api/payments/*`, `/api/ledger/*`, `/api/products/*`, `/api/batches/*`, `/api/returns/*`.
7. Regulatory Reports: `/api/reports/audit`, `/api/reports/schedule-h1`, `/api/reports/gst`, etc.
